messages:
Asha K: hey @here quick Q — i'm a temporary guardian for my niece (placement just happened). need to add her to my benefits but i'm waiting on the court guardian affidavit. carrier site says affidavit + placement letter within 30 days. payroll cutoff for new dependents is this Fri. can we get an enrollment exception if docs come after payroll?
Maya (People Ops): hi Asha — congrats and thanks for flagging. we can usually approve an exception for temporary guardianship up to 60 days if you submit a valid sworn affidavit + placement letter. need case number or judge signature. do you have an estimated upload date? :memo:
Asha K: thanks Maya — court clerk said affidavit will be ready next week (prob tues). placement letter i have now. ssn is pending (we applied, processing with SSA). will that block enrollment?
Claire (Benefits Admin): SSN pending is common. carriers accept "SSN pending" when you provide the affidavit + placement docs and an SSA issuance receipt or proof of application. if SSN never arrives, you may need to submit an ITIN or follow up docs per carrier. we can proceed conditionally.
Jon (Payroll): FYI payroll cutoffs: additions must be submitted in Workday by 11:59pm PT the day before payroll snapshot (this Fri). if docs arrive after that, we can still retro-enroll the dependent to the placement date if it's within the carrier's allowed retro window (usually 60 days). retro premium adjustments will be handled on next paycheck.
Asha K: ok great — so plan: i'll upload placement letter now to Workday and affidavit next tues. SSN proof will be uploaded when available. any specific file names or checkboxes to use?
Maya (People Ops): please use Workday > Benefits > 'Add Dependent QLE' and upload files named: 'placement_letter_<last4>' and 'guardian_affidavit_<last4>'. in the notes field put 'temporary guardian placement date: 2026-03-15 — SSN pending' so we don't lose context. i'll mark this thread for case review. :white_check_mark:
BenefitsBot: Reminder: file size limit 25MB. If you need to redact any sensitive content, send to people-ops@redwood.com and we'll handle secure upload.
Claire (Benefits Admin): i'll tentatively approve exception once affidavit is uploaded and case number present. Jon — heads up in case we need retro premium reconciliation for Asha.
Jon (Payroll): got it, thanks. i'll queue retro calc if needed. tag me @Jon in the Workday case.
Asha K: thanks everyone — uploading placement letter now. appreciate the fast help :heart:
